title: userpath
summary: Query the default user path or normalize a user-path request.

gpu_support.notes: User-path metadata is host-only. Numeric and provider-resident values are rejected before provider or search-path access.

description: `userpath` returns RunMat's default user path. `userpath('reset')`, `userpath('clear')`, and `userpath(newpath)` return the corresponding normalized path value.
behaviors: Accepts no input or one host string scalar or character row vector.
The default path is the `Documents/MATLAB` directory beneath the active home directory when that directory can be resolved.
The current implementation returns the requested value but does not persistently change the session search path; persistent user-path mutation remains an implementation gap.
Numeric values, including native integer values, are not path text and are rejected before provider or search-path access.
